stories.title: Corporate America Is Getting Hooked on Open-Source A.I.
stories.simple_summary: Big companies are increasingly using free, open-source AI tools (AI that anybody can copy and modify) instead of paying for expensive AI from big tech companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large corporations — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Congress of Scholas Chairs reflects on challenges of AI
stories.simple_summary: Religious leaders met to discuss challenges that come with artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a religious discussion — nothing specific you need to act on.

stories.title: U.S. Bishops Focus On Young People, Artificial Intelligence in Labor Day Message
stories.simple_summary: U.S. Catholic bishops released a message highlighting concerns about AI and its effects on young people.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a statement of concerns rather than a change affecting you — nothing specific you need to act on.

stories.title: Yes, We’re Entering the Era of Artificial General Intelligence
stories.simple_summary: An article claims we are entering a new era where AI becomes as general and smart as human intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly speculation and discussion for tech industry people — nothing concrete you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Instagram’s AI detection is a mess (again)
stories.simple_summary: Instagram's system that labels AI-made pictures is making mistakes and labeling regular photos as AI-generated when they aren't.
stories.why_it_matters: If you post photos on Instagram, they might get wrongly labeled as AI-made, which could confuse your followers about what's real.

stories.title: Why AI food looks like that
stories.simple_summary: Restaurants and brands are using AI to create food pictures for their ads, and the results look weird and unappetizing — like melted blobs instead of real food.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a restaurant or food business, this is a warning: using AI to make cheap food pictures backfires because customers can tell something looks wrong and it hurts your reputation.

stories.title: Microsoft’s Project Zenith is a ‘distraction-free Windows experience’ for developers
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft created a new version of Windows designed specifically for computer programmers, with a simpler, distraction-free setup.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you're a software developer, this doesn't affect you — it's a specialized tool for tech workers.

stories.title: Sam Altman apologizes for ‘messy’ GPT-6 Astra rollout that’s locked out paying users
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released a new, very advanced AI tool called GPT-6 Astra, but the launch was messy and some customers paying for it couldn't access it right away.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use OpenAI's paid services, there may be access problems with new features, though the company is working to fix it.

stories.title: This NAS company wants to run your local smart home
stories.simple_summary: A company that makes phone chargers and storage devices is now selling an AI-powered smart home system that runs cameras, security, and home controls all from your own home device.
stories.why_it_matters: This gives you another option for a smart home system if you want security cameras and home automation managed locally on your own equipment.

stories.title: AI's 'warning shot': Tech companies, experts raise fears of more rogue swarms after alarming Hugging Face hack
stories.simple_summary: Computer security experts are warning about hacking attacks on AI companies, describing a recent major hack as a serious warning sign of more trouble coming.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a warning for tech industry professionals — for now, just use strong passwords and stay cautious online like you always should.

stories.title: The sameness problem behind those unappetizing AI-generated menus
stories.simple_summary: Restaurant owners using AI to create pictures of their food may think they're taking a shortcut, but customers notice the pictures look fake and unappetizing.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a restaurant or food business, don't use AI to fake your menu photos — customers will notice and trust you less.

stories.title: Crusoe reportedly raises $3B at a  $30B valuation
stories.simple_summary: A data center company (a company that stores and manages computer information) raised $3 billion in investment money.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.
